EICMA 2026 • Yamaha Births New Adventure Scooter Family, Three RW Models That Look More Like Motorcycles
Upcoming Fiat Koala, the Italian Citroen 2CV, Also Gains a Hybrid Version Across Imagination Land
8 photos
Photo: kdesignag / Instagram
Back at the 2026 Paris Motor Show, the massive Stellantis group decided to rule the event in Paris with over 60 brand-new vehicles – nine of them being concept cars.
There was even a ‘The Night Before’ event just like in the good old days of major automotive shows with plenty of reveals – Alfa Romeo, Citroen, DS Automobiles, Fiat, Opel, and Peugeot presented six of the most important prototypes: Cuorerosso, 2 CV Concept, DS F3VER, Multiplay , STX Concept, and the RCZ Vision.
Of them all, the rumor mill is pretty sure that the Citroen 2CV will enter series production, with Stellantis looking to revive the spirit of the legendary original but with modern traits: fully electric, made in Europe, and accessible at a starting price of €15k. The accompanying concept was more than fancy, but most likely the real Citroen will be a bit more serious – the French automaker already has experience with the barren Ami quadricycle.
But, as it turns out, the new Citroen 2CV won’t come alone to make sure it becomes even less expensive to produce – Fiat’s next European city car got a fresh name and slated production in Italy alongside the French version. Called Fiat Koala, the new city EV was actually expected to arrive at the 2026 Paris Motor Show, but instead Fiat graced us with the Multiplay, a concept hinting at a potential successor for the rather unpopular Multipla compact minivan.
Set to arrive in 2027, the upcoming Fiat Koala was only revealed by name by Arnauld Belloni, Fiat's new CEO, during an interview at the 2026 Paris Motor Show, and obviously nobody knows its exact looks. No worries, as the rumor mill has quickly joined the chat and the members of the imaginative guild of digital car content creators have stopped dwelling across the parallel universes of vehicular CGI to lend a helping hand.
For example, Kleber Silva, a Brazil-based virtual artist known as " KDesign AG " on social media, has decided to have a CGI go at imagining the next small Fiat and created their vision of the Koala for their latest unofficial, hypothetical design project. Based on the new Stellantis E-Car platform, the Fiat Koala will be one of the group’s upcoming electric city cars targeting a new category by the European Union promoting small and affordable EVs – kind of like the Japanese kei cars but with batteries only.
Anyway, the pixel master not only imagined the design of the new model but also took things a step forward, envisioning the potentially even more affordable Fiat Koala Hybrid version. It has a funky design with retro elements like the square headlights plus taillights and the third color mixed with the main orange-and-black dual-tone attire, plus an upright stance to allow enough space for all four people.
